sources.disposition: Supports the practical precedent/model sense and に construction. Preserve the instructional 習う contrast without claiming the two words have unrelated historical origins. No historical derivation is needed for the planned card.

sources.actualHeading: 精選版 日本国語大辞典: も‐ほう‥ハウ【模倣・摸倣】 and separate ぼ‐ほう‥ハウ【模倣】
sources.inspection: The inspected noun entry describes imitation and similar expressions of actions/attitudes/habits/thought; a separately headed ぼほう entry is equivalent and has a historical citation. Nipponica separately describes behavioral observation and artistic imitation.
sources.disposition: Supports the selected modern teaching identity 模倣 もほう and a broad imitation sense, not a fraud-only meaning. Retain the additional dictionary reading as evidence outside the frozen selected JMdict family, without replacing the existing primary もほう or assigning ボ to 倣.
sources.limits: Returned Daijisen, 字通 and Britannica sections contained headings/attribution without their definitions; they are not verified definitions. Encyclopedia psychological/art claims and historical example collocations are not generalized into the practical lesson.

sources.actualHeading: デジタル大辞泉: ほう【倣】［漢字項目］
sources.inspection: The actual character entry gives ホウ, ならう, the imitation meaning and 模倣 as its compound example. A separate 字通 entry gives ten strokes, a phonetic analysis with 放 and additional historical glosses.
sources.disposition: Supports both frozen teaching readings and direct ホウ allocation in 模倣, separately from whole-word kana matching. Canonical KANJIDIC2 人/no9 remains metadata, with visible 亻 explained as such. Prefer a labelled modern-shape mnemonic instead of adopting the historical analysis in this bounded packet.
